<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We show that in quantum computation almost every gate that operates on two or more bits is a universal gate. We discuss various physical considerations bearing on the proper definition of universality for computational components such as logic gates.</jats:p>
title: Universality in quantum computation
